passage.label: Considered al-Lat al-Uzza; Manat third other; male you Him female; unjust division; not but names named forefathers Allah sent down no authority; follow not except assumption souls desire already come Lord guidance; man whatever wishes; rather Allah belongs Hereafter first life; many angels heavens intercession not avail except after Allah permitted wills approves; indeed not believe Hereafter name angels female names; thereof no knowledge follow not except assumption avails not against truth; turn away whoever turns back message desires not except worldly life; sum knowledge; indeed Lord most knowing strays way most knowing guided; Allah belongs whatever heavens earth recompense evil penalty done recompense good best reward; avoid major sins immoralities only slight ones; indeed Lord vast forgiveness; most knowing produced earth fetuses wombs mothers; do not claim yourselves pure; most knowing fears Him

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا
فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى

ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

mainSubject.label: Al-Lat, al-Uzza and Manat challenged as mere names invented without divine authority, their gendered attribution exposed as unjust division; followers relying on assumption and soul-desire despite prior guidance; man's wishes limited since the Hereafter and first life belong to Allah; angelic intercession restricted to divine permission and approval; those naming angels female lacking knowledge and following assumption that avails nothing against truth; turning away from whoever rejects the message for worldly life alone, their knowledge summed up while Allah knows best who strays and who is guided; cosmic ownership affirming exact recompense for evil and best reward for good; avoiders of major sins and immoralities granted vast forgiveness, with self-purification claims rejected since Allah knew them from earth-production and fetal stages and knows best who fears Him

subordinateSubjects.label: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza
And Manat the third, the other one
Is the male for you and for Him the female — an unjust division
They are not but names you and your forefathers named without divine authority, following only assumption and soul-desire
Guidance having already come from their Lord
Or is there for man whatever he wishes
Rather to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first life
Many angels in the heavens whose intercession avails only after divine permission and approval
Those disbelieving in the Hereafter name angels female without knowledge, following assumption that avails nothing against truth
Turn away from whoever turns his back on the message desiring only worldly life
That is their sum of knowledge; your Lord knows best who strays and who is guided
To Allah belongs all in heavens and earth for exact recompense of evil and best reward for good
Avoiders of major sins and immoralities granted vast forgiveness; He knew you from earth-production and fetal stages
Do not claim yourselves pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-signs affirmation (18) before the idol-challenge block opens (19); P2 ends with the self-purification prohibition (32) before the Musa-Ibrahim scripture reminders begin (33); P3 runs through the ethical axioms, divine attributes and destruction catalogue closing with the favors question (33-55); P4 covers the warner-identity, Approaching Day, their misplaced wonder and the closing prostration command (56-62).
